result.topic_en: A differential formula for the location of a centre (Loc. C. M) involving two conic terms with eccentricities e, e' and parameters p, p', followed by two triangular tables of numerical coefficients resembling series-expansion (Bernoulli-type) coefficients.

methods.what: Differential expression for a location coordinate as a weighted combination of two conic-section (Keplerian orbit) terms with eccentricities e and e'
methods.quote:
$\partial\, \mathrm{Loc.\,C.\,M} = $ [-$\partial l g v$-] $- \frac{p}{p-p'} \frac{\partial\, l g v}{(1+e\cos l g v - a_p.)^2}$
$- \frac{p'}{p-p'} \frac{\partial\, l g v}{(1+e'\cos l g v - a_{p'})^2}$

methods.what: Table of numerical coefficients (with factorial-reciprocal prefactors) of a series expansion, numbers like 1, 5, 9, 251, 475, 19087, 36799 resembling Adams–Bashforth/Gregory-type integration coefficients
